note: The company's facts, one home each. tools/seo-head.py builds the Organization node of every page from them, and puts the ones tools/templates/footer.html names (${email} and the others) into the footer. sentence is the company sentence (AGENTS.md, "One sentence about the company"); the pages, llms.txt and the guides repeat it by hand, so change those with it. footer_sentence is the footer's shorter wording: the sentence without its first two words and its last sentence, its first letter then a capital. tools/verify/copies.js fails when the two drift apart. The generated languages translate footer_sentence as a message of its own.
